lore: Every save the harbour lands still has to cross the old toll bridge to reach the archive. The bridge is fine with a steady stream, but if more than a hundred and eighty carts cross in any twenty ticks it starts to sway. Tollkeeper Bram used to count carts per hour and close the gate when the hour's quota was spent, until two storms an hour apart came either side of the hour bell and nearly took the bridge down. Now he keeps a jar of tokens that slowly refills, and the only question is how big a jar.

lines.start: One token per cart, six drips a tick, and the jar holds what it holds.
lines.toll: Token? Across you go. No token? Back off and try later.
lines.sway: Feel that? Too many carts at once. The bridge is swaying!
lines.win: Whole season across and the bridge never swayed. Hardly a cart turned back.
lines.fail: Either the bridge swayed or I turned half the island away. Size that jar again.
